messages.subject: Root-cause report ENG-RCA-2025-117 - for legal
messages.plaintextBody:
Sophie, Raj,

The root-cause report is finalised (ENG-RCA-2025-117). Summary: boundary-cell error in the blend map at low-mu/high-jerk; regen ramps down before friction pressure leads, ~300-600ms force gap. Build 4.3.0 fixes it and passes the extended suite (812/812). Energy recovery down only 0.4%.

Copying Tom at Whitfield Carter as requested so it sits under privilege.

Caroline

—
Calderwell Mobility Limited
Pioneer House, Trafford Park, Manchester M17 1WA
